Sec 2.2 Macro Design / Table 10: "This improves the model accuracy from 78.8% to 79.4%." 78.8% is the enhanced-recipe ResNet-50 baseline (Table 10, 78.82 ± 0.07) that the modernization roadmap starts from -- the authors' own trained baseline.
Sec 2.6 Micro Design, "Substituting BN with LN": "obtaining an accuracy of 81.5%." Matches Table 10's BN→LN roadmap step (81.47 ± 0.09). Own roadmap experiment.

Text at this location reads "We can improve the accuracy to 82.0%" (Sec 2.6, separate-downsampling step, itself an own result matching Table 10's ConvNeXt-T row 81.97). The captured value 82.04 does not equal the printed 82.0 here -- it is Table 11's (main.tex:853) 'move up depthwise conv' ResNet-200-regime accuracy, misbound to this location's text. 82.04 is nonetheless a real number the paper reports (Table 11) and is itself the authors' own roadmap result, so it is judged on that (metric, value) pair rather than on the mismatched location, per the same principle used for barlowtwins' places-205=54.1 case.
Sec 3.2 ImageNet-22K: "our ConvNeXt-XL model achieves an accuracy of 87.8%" -- matches Table 1 and the abstract. The paper's own result.
